title: Egyptian Lamb Wrap
description: A flavorful Middle Eastern-inspired wrap filled with tender lamb, crispy lettuce, creamy tahini sauce, and tangy pickled turnips.
instructions: Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
In a large bowl, combine lamb, salt, black pepper, and garlic powder. Mix well with your hands until just combined.
Form lamb mixture into 4-6 small patties, depending on desired size.
Grill lamb patties for 4-5 minutes per side, or until cooked to your desired level of doneness. Transfer to a plate and cover with foil to keep warm.
Warm pita bread by wrapping in foil and heating in the oven at 350°F (180°C) for 5 minutes.
Assemble wraps by spreading a layer of tahini sauce on each pita bread, followed by a few slices of grilled lamb, some chopped lettuce, and a spoonful of pickled turnips.
Drizzle with olive oil and garnish with chopped parsley.
